clarifications: Legacy Lease.Do can otherwise return a nonnil callback error while discarding a different outer authorizer failure. The selected capture-only callback avoids that existing branch; it neither changes Lease.Do nor adds a new lease/authority API.

Keep the callback's captured original source failure when classifying a failed complete lease. In particular, a captured poisoned clock write plus an outer unauthorized/unknown failure must still latch the selected server's poison state and return outcome_unknown. Delegating a poison+unauthorized join to the old unauthorized-first classifier is insufficient.
The existing wrapped/joined expiry-looking refusal cases remain failures. Their labels do not authorize a new serialized error or reinterpret a foreign expiry as the original clock branch.
Exact clock capacity may latch the existing intake hold only after complete original lease success. Clock metadata uncertainty remains separate from the exactly zero admission-count tuple.
